    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Persistent Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5289) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

**Prerequisites**
[Emit Defensive Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5278)

</column>

---

Your pheromones now linger on creatures. When a target fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor ability, they also take 1d6 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level.
